newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy gives jail terms to five GIA supporters.
newsitem.headline: Italy gives jail terms to five GIA supporters.

text.p: An Italian court on Monday handed down jail terms to five men accused of supplying false documents and other support to Algeria's radical Armed Islamic Group (GIA), a court official said.
Hamel Abderraim, Kamel El Hait, Ben Ali Saiah, Djamel Boukheddache and Boualem Bouguerrouma were given prison sentences ranging from three years four months to one year and two months.
Prosecutors said terrorism charges had not been filed as none of the defendants had been involved in direct attacks on the Italian state.
The five men were arrested last November along with 20 other people in a police sweep against alleged GIA supporters.

Prosecutors said at the time they believed the suspects had given logistical support for a wave of bomb attacks in France in 1995, which killed eight people and were blamed on Algerian Moslem extremists.
